name: orphograph
description: Bitcoin-anchored file timestamping for Claude Code — prove a file existed at a specific moment without uploading it. Only the SHA-256 hash leaves your machine.

plugins.name: orphograph
plugins.description: Anchor any file to the Bitcoin blockchain from inside Claude Code — the file never leaves your machine, only its 32-byte SHA-256 fingerprint. /orphograph:anchor to timestamp, /orphograph:verify to check (offline, no key). For developers, researchers, journalists, and photographers who need provenance for their own work, including pre-AI-cutoff proof.
